description: A portfolio manager is tracking the performance of 5 different product lines over 5 years. They need to proactively identify which products are entering the 'Decline' phase and suggest pivot strategies or sunsetting based on long-term usage data and market shifts.

user_profile.context: Annual strategic review of the entire product portfolio
user_profile.communication_style: Strategic, looks at the 'big picture' and historical trends

fact_sheet.fact: Innovatech Solutions Inc. manages five core product lines: ConnectSphere, DataWeave, SecureVault, FlowBuilder, and PixelPerfect.
ConnectSphere, a communication platform, is the oldest product in the portfolio, launched on July 15, 2018.
FlowBuilder, a workflow automation tool, is the newest product, launched on February 1, 2022.
SecureVault is a cybersecurity suite targeted at financial services companies with 500-5000 employees.
The PixelPerfect design suite was acquired from 'Designlytics Corp.' for $12 million in Q2 2019.
ConnectSphere's Monthly Active Users (MAU) peaked at 450,000 in Q2 2020 and have since declined to 95,000 as of Q4 2023.
DataWeave's annual customer churn rate increased from 4% in 2022 to 9.5% in 2023.
SecureVault's Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) has consistently grown, reaching $85,000 in FY 2023, up from $72,000 in FY 2022.
PixelPerfect's Net Promoter Score (NPS) dropped from 55 in January 2022 to 32 in December 2023.
FlowBuilder has the lowest Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) in the portfolio at $118 per customer for Q4 2023.
ConnectSphere's annual revenue for FY 2023 was $2.5M, a 38% decrease from its $4.0M revenue in FY 2022.
The average number of API calls per month for DataWeave customers has decreased by 25% over the last four quarters.
SecureVault successfully acquired 3 new enterprise clients in Q4 2023, with a total contract value of $1.1M.
A major competitor, 'Synapse Analytics,' launched a rival product to DataWeave in Q1 2023, capturing an estimated 5% market share within 9 months.
The global market for team communication tools, ConnectSphere's primary market, became saturated with three major new entrants in 2022.
A Forrester Wave report from October 2023 on design tools highlighted AI-assisted features as a key differentiator, a capability PixelPerfect currently lacks.
The market for enterprise cybersecurity solutions is projected by Gartner to grow at a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 14% from 2024 to 2028.
Eleanor Vance holds the title of VP of Product and is responsible for the overall portfolio strategy.
Marcus Thorne is the Senior Portfolio Manager who prepares the Quarterly Product Performance Review (QPPR) deck.
The product manager for ConnectSphere, David Chen, resigned on November 10, 2023; the position is currently open.
The live 'Innovatech Portfolio Dashboard' is hosted on a Tableau Server at the URL `https://bi.innovatech.internal/dashboards/portfolio-overview`.
Raw usage data for all products is stored in a Snowflake data warehouse, schema `PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_PROD`.
The annual strategic review presentation is stored on the shared drive at `//share/Exec/Strategy/FY2024_Annual_Review_v3.pptx`.
A proposal to sunset the ConnectSphere product line by Q3 2024 was formally submitted by Marcus Thorne on December 5, 2023.
Project 'Phoenix' was initiated in November 2023 to explore integrating DataWeave's analytics engine into the FlowBuilder product.
The R&D budget allocated to PixelPerfect for FY 2024 has been reduced by 30% to $700,000.
ConnectSphere's annual revenue fell by $1.5M from FY 2022 to FY 2023, dropping from $4.0M to $2.5M.
PixelPerfect's Net Promoter Score declined by 23 points between January 2022 and December 2023, moving from 55 to 32.
Project 'Phoenix' was launched in November 2023 as the strategic initiative for DataWeave, focused on integrating DataWeave's analytics engine into FlowBuilder.
SecureVault's Customer Lifetime Value increased by $13,000 from FY 2022 to FY 2023, rising from $72,000 to $85,000.
PixelPerfect's FY 2024 R&D budget is $700,000 after a 30% cut from the prior $1,000,000 allocation.
The current annual maintenance and support cost for the ConnectSphere infrastructure is $480,000.

user_needs.description: Let's start with the big picture on underperforming assets. What were ConnectSphere's annual revenues in FY 2022 and FY 2023?
Show me the user engagement trend for ConnectSphere. What was its peak Monthly Active User count and what is it as of Q4 2023?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After seeing a significant revenue drop for ConnectSphere, the user will naturally want to investigate the underlying usage metrics.

user_needs.description: What was DataWeave's annual customer churn rate in 2022 versus 2023?
Is usage intensity also down for DataWeave? By how much has the average number of API calls per customer decreased over the last year?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Following up on increased customer churn for DataWeave, the user will likely probe deeper into the engagement levels of the remaining customers.

user_needs.description: Now, let's look at PixelPerfect. What were its Net Promoter Score values in January 2022 and December 2023?
To get a baseline, what was SecureVault's Customer Lifetime Value in FY 2022 and FY 2023?
What was SecureVault's new enterprise contract value in Q4 2023?
Given ConnectSphere's declining performance, what is its current annual maintenance and support cost?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After establishing ConnectSphere's steep decline in revenue and usage, a strategic leader's next question is about the associated costs to assess its overall financial drain.

user_needs.description: With those numbers in mind, has a formal proposal been made to sunset the ConnectSphere product line?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the user understands the high cost associated with the underperforming ConnectSphere, they will want to know what strategic actions are on the table, such as sunsetting.

user_needs.description: What strategic initiative involving DataWeave is currently underway, and what is it focused on?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing DataWeave's negative churn and usage metrics, the user will naturally ask about the plan or project in place to mitigate these problems.

user_needs.description: What did the latest Forrester Wave identify as a key differentiator in design tools, and does PixelPerfect have it?
What is PixelPerfect's FY2024 R&D budget after the reduction?
Regarding the ConnectSphere sunset proposal, what is the current product manager staffing status for that product line?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After learning about a formal proposal to sunset ConnectSphere, the user might ask about the product's leadership to gauge the feasibility and internal momentum behind the proposal.
